categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Cai Qin Technology Co., Ltd primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-end advanced electronic ceramic components including filters, resonators, antennas, low intermodulation passive components, high-performance ceramic structures and functional devices, RF modules and systems. The products serve diverse sectors such as mobile communications, radar, RF circuits, satellite communications, aerospace, defense, new energy, semiconductors, IoT, and consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary microwave dielectric ceramic powder formulations and manufacturing processes, including advanced microwave dielectric ceramic material preparation, high-performance dielectric waveguide filter technology, large-size dielectric filter manufacturing and assembly, complex ceramic one-time forming, blind hole metallization and silver brazing, TEM dielectric filter technology, high-performance dielectric resonator technology, dielectric antenna and antenna component technology, and low intermodulation passive component technology. Production covers the full chain from ceramic powder preparation to finished components with flexible multi-variety production modes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global communication equipment manufacturers such as Huawei, Comba Telecom, Qualcomm, China Information and Communication Technology Group, Nokia, and Ericsson, as well as aerospace and defense enterprises like China Electronics Technology Group Corporation and Aviation Industry Corporation of China. The products are widely used in communication base stations, aerospace, defense, new energy, semiconductor, IoT, and consumer electronics markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant sales in regions including South China, East China, North China, Southwest China, and other domestic areas. It also serves overseas markets, though overseas revenue is a smaller portion. The company has subsidiaries and production facilities mainly in Zhangjiagang and Suzhou, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Cai Qin Technology operates upstream in the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of core electronic ceramic components and modules used by communication equipment manufacturers and other downstream industries. It controls the entire production process from raw material preparation to finished product delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in electronic ceramic materials and components, focusing on expanding microwave dielectric ceramic material systems, HTCC high-end electronic ceramics, and new application fields such as new energy, semiconductors, IoT, and consumer electronics. It invests heavily in R&D to maintain leadership in RF ceramic components for communication base stations and to develop advanced ceramic materials and processing technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized electronic ceramic components and modules to communication equipment manufacturers and other industrial clients. The company operates mainly on a direct sales model with production based on customer orders, supplemented by some distribution. Revenue recognition follows delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic supplier of microwave dielectric ceramic components, especially dielectric waveguide filters for 5G base stations, competing with firms like Wuhan Fanggu, Dongshan Precision, Chunxing Precision, Dafu Technology, Guoren Communication, and international players such as Kyocera and Trans-Tech. It holds a strong market position with recognized technology and scale advantages in China and is expanding its presence internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 410.9 million, representing an 11.09% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 57.79 million, a 23.66% increase. The company has total assets of RMB 2.57 billion and net assets of RMB 2.18 billion, showing steady growth. R&D investment accounts for about 9.63% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary ceramic powder formulations and advanced manufacturing processes that yield high-Q, low-loss, temperature-stable, miniaturized, and cost-effective dielectric ceramic components. Its products offer superior electrical performance, reliability, and scalability for 4G/5G base stations and aerospace applications. The company’s integrated R&D and production capabilities enable customized solutions and rapid response to market demands, securing strong partnerships with leading global communication equipment manufacturers.
